citation: 'MARSHALL FIELD PRAIRIE AVE.' Engraving of the house from Prairie Avenue, publication not named (file '1893marshallfieldhouse'). Reproduced on chicagology.com, Prairie Avenue, 1905 S. Prairie.
author: unknown engraver
date: 1893 (per the file name; publication not named)
repository: chicagology.com (secondary reproduction; the original holder is not named). Prairie library image a19-cgy-1905-field-1893-engraving, recorded there as 'link only'; the project's reference copy is the image store's (kevinrhaas/chicago-images, prairie-1904/files/a19-cgy-1905-field-1893-engraving.jpg), committed since T-3271 at data/sources/assets/field_1905_pictures_t3271/ with its attribution, as the owner directed on 2026-10-11 for the image gate's pictures.
locator: The whole engraving: the street front from its north end, half hidden by a tree in leaf, the stoop, the canted south-west corner with a balcony at the chamber floor, the conservatory on the south flank under its curved roof with a railed deck, the mansard with dormers and iron cresting, the arched basement lights and the scroll-pattern iron fence along the walk.
rights_note: A secondary web reproduction whose original source and rights are not stated (the Prairie library's ruling: 'unknown - link only'). Forms, counts and places are read from it; nothing is derived from the image as an asset, and the copy committed for the image gate is the store's, unaltered.

note: A drawing: its perspective is looser than a photograph's (its camera closes at about 20 px, a metre at the house), and a tree hides the front's middle. Its camera is solved in data/reference_views/marshall_field_house_1905_prairie/chicagology_engraving.json.
